k1.profile_notes: No waist joint/pelvis shell; hips/trunk boundary is not equivalent to articulated-waist robots.

t800.profile_notes: No wrist or separate hand model: hand zones unavailable; forearm terminal shell takes hand slots.

mimickit.profile_notes: Wrist boundary is welded hand body origin, not a wrist joint. Auto primitive fallback uses experimental winding patch; interior check is diagnostic.

g1_racket.profile_notes: Human-only control of task variant; native AdaPT composite source is not used. Tool-racket transfers are separate from anatomical hand zones.

g1_spherehand.profile_notes: Auto surface selection excludes ankle/foot meshes with contact flags. Foot zones absent from selected surface, although full model has feet. Overlay exposes omitted geometry.

primitive.production_failure: Production binding rejected: 470 buried projections (36 cross-body).
